create_subgraph_node: create a subgraph Node with a name string for use in a graph structure
create_subgraph_edge: create a subgraph Edge connecting two Node instances in a directed graph
build_subgraph_graph: build a subgraph Graph with a name, a set of nodes, and a set of edges
test_subgraph_hashable: test that two subgraph Graph instances with identical content produce equal hashes
run_topological_sort: run topological sort on a list of subgraph Edge instances to get ordered nodes
